C0925.title: Zaozhuang Police Dismantle Fake Recruitment Fraud Ring, Recover Over 1.5 Million Yuan
C0925.summary: In September 2024, police in Zaozhuang dismantled a criminal gang that defrauded job seekers under the guise of recruitment. The gang registered a human resources company and posted fake state-owned enterprise job advertisements on online media platforms, tricking victims into paying over 1.5 million yuan by promising job placements after attending 'high-end training'.

references.title: Zaozhuang police dismantle a fake recruitment fraud ring, returning over 1.5 million yuan in stolen funds on the spot
